page.layout: One printed page, framed by an ornamental woodcut border; running head with page number at top; title block centred within the frame. No margin notes on the printed page. Left edge shows show-through/neighbouring page, not transcribed.

main_text.l: Metallorum transformatione, adversus HAGELII & PERERII Jesuitarum opiniones.
Divinæ & humanæ Sapientiæ Parenti; Domino meo Clementissimo.
Hancce Revisi recusiq; opusculi subcisivi diatriben Chymicam,

page.notes: Title page with decorative woodcut border. The running head reads "DISQVISITIO HELIANA" with "103" at the right; the page number is taken from it. Long s rendered as s throughout.
